feedback: Fails reward safety and progress-reward checks. (1) Reward safety: (u0, pot_boiling & holding_food, u1) -> 0.1 rewards a boil onset when the agent is carrying food, but the agent cannot turn the stove down with full hands (stove_fixed never holds with holding_food); the 0.1 can be repeatedly farmed by picking up/dropping food while the pot boils, since the machine accepts an u0->u1/u2 boil transition on every new boil and after stove_fixed the episode loops. More generally, 0.1 on boil onset rewards the harmful event rather than only progress toward its fix, so the plan 'let it boil while holding food' gains reward — a wrong plan that never turns the stove down still collects 0.1 per boil. (2) Dense-but-bounded progress: after entering u2 (boiling, empty hands) there is no intermediate shaping; that part is fine, but the problematic shaping is the onset reward in u1 which is unfixable until food is dropped, yet still pays. (3) Reachability/coverage of states: u1 is reachable, but no transition out of u1 to u2 exists if the agent drops food while the pot still boils — the machine requires !pot_boiling to leave u1, so an agent who correctly puts food down to free its hands (per the environment rules: turn stove down only with empty hands) is stuck in u1 and can never reach u3 or collect the 1.0 reward; the wait-state handling of dropping food mid-boil (u1 with holding_food becoming false while still boiling) is missing, making the correct behavior unreachable in the machine. Declare an explicit transition (u1, !holding_food & pot_boiling) -> u2 (or equivalent) and remove the 0.1 on boil onset (keep any shaping only on stove_fixed or on the empty-hands drop), then the machine would be acceptable.
